subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw maintain a repository-owned Microsoft tracker generator that can edit pull-request bodies, or should this tracking remain outside the source repository and GitHub mutation tooling?
rationale: This is a new maintainer workflow and GitHub mutation boundary rather than a repair to an established product contract; implementation quality alone cannot select its long-term ownership or permitted side effects.

options.title: Keep tracking external
options.body: Close or replace this branch and use GitHub search, labels, or a separately owned project/dashboard for live Microsoft triage.

options.title: Adopt read-only tracker
options.body: Retain only a reviewed, deterministic report generator with fixture tests and no capability to edit GitHub PR bodies.

options.title: Adopt managed mutation workflow
options.body: Authorize PR-body updates only with a named owner, explicit escaping contract, safe dry-run mode, and documented operational review process.

recommendation.title: Keep tracking external
recommendation.body: Close or replace this branch and use GitHub search, labels, or a separately owned project/dashboard for live Microsoft triage.

likelyOwner.reason: Low-confidence routing candidate for the repository-wide workflow and release-owned changelog decision.
